answer_1.quote: We address the task of controlling natural language generation in terms of the discourse structure of the generated text.
answer_1.outputs: Generated texts reflecting specified rhetorical structures

answer_2.quote: We use the Standard Parse-Eval metric. ... We also use BLEU, ROUGE, and METEOR (MTR) ... BLEU-4 (B-4), ... ROUGE-L (R-L), ... METEOR ... BERTscore (B-S) ... perplexity (PPL) ... recall of discourse markers (DM) ... GRUEN
